results.title: Your House
results.overview: Four homes share a looming threat.

results.title: Alter Yellow - Jaune Passion
results.overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this first episode, we follow a couple slowly falling apart because of the space a camera takes in the life of one of the two girls. This will create the dilemma: 'It's it or me!'

results.title: Okinawa Saudade
results.original_title: オキナワ・サウダージ
results.overview: A documentary depicting the journey of Okinawan-Brazilian descendants returning to their ancestral homeland and engaging with its history and culture.

results.title: I'm Nothing Special Really
results.overview: Feri breaks up with her long-term boyfriend when she sees him getting intimate with his ex. Meanwhile, Navid likes Feri's sister Mariam and tries to get close to her, but an unexpected encounter changes the course of their relationship. Still feeling the pain of heartbreak, Feri sets off with Mariam in search of peace of mind.

results.title: Silt
results.overview: Hadria, haunted by guilt she cannot explain, is talked into a weekend at an exclusive lakeside sanctuary by her best friend Sierra, and Sierra’s boyfriend Scott. She has never warmed to the hosts, Rick and Anna, but she goes for a shot at something with Mike Warner, a pro athlete sidelined by a knee injury. The property sits behind three locked gates, where hundreds of deer assemble, watching. The lake comes with lore, the kind that makes a good firepit story, and Bartleby, the eccentric owner, tells them it carries the genes of the Gods. Hadria doesn’t buy any of it, right up until the water starts proving Bartleby right.

results.title: Vanished 2: Legend of the Mask
results.overview: Three friends investigate the mysterious legend of the Masked Monster.

results.title: Jonnie Wick
results.overview: After his cat is murdered, Jonnie Wick goes on a vengeful rampage to track down and kill the main man responsible

results.title: Drama chez les Queens
results.overview: Inspector Pony investigates a mysterious "murder" among drag queens.

results.title: Les monstres
results.overview: Car broken down, a couple dreads the monsters lurking in the night.

results.title: L'enquête de mon coeur
results.overview: In the auto-fiction film L'enquête de mon cœur, French filmmaker Philippe Vallois wakes up to a strange reality: evidence and witnesses prove he spent the winter in a passionate romance with Bruno, a young Brazilian man. However, the director suffers from complete amnesia regarding the last three months. With Bruno already back in Brazil, Vallois launches a personal investigation to uncover his own forgotten story. Blending documentary and fiction, he attempts to piece together and virtually relive the romance using video footage from his camera, his personal journal, and the accounts of close friends.

results.title: PH1SHed_
results.overview: An ethical hacker sticks up for a friend who fell victim to a phishing scam, but finds herself descending into paranoia as she gets caught up in a risky game of cat and mouse with a dangerous blackhat cyber criminal.

results.title: I'M OKAY
results.overview: Beginning with a conversation with a man. Those conversations may have truly happened, or they may exist only within his own mind. In an attempt to hold on to something, he steals objects from his ex-boyfriend—things that seem useless, insignificant, and easily forgotten. As reality and imagination gradually blur together, he finally comes to understand where a relationship ultimately ends.

results.title: The Guy On The Ground
results.overview: The last known footage of a disgraced news broadcaster, Bill Marquette, is found amid a police database leak. After a tip about a news story that could help revive his career, he was never seen or heard from again.

results.title: Lulu Got a New Roommate
results.overview: A ladybug Ronnie accidentally got stuck in a spider Lulu's web while building its nest. What can it do to escape? This is a story about friendship and Chinese puns about insects.

results.title: Nothing
results.overview: Time passes by as a man tries to navigate the monotony of every day life.

results.title: Sara
results.overview: Sara runs away from a party, overwhelmed by her father's pressure to be the "perfect daughter," and heads out to pursue her passion for photography, determined to do what she loves without fearing the consequences.

results.title: Pickpockets
results.overview: The flirty rivalry between a lone-wolf pickpocket and a charismatic rookie escalates into a spiteful turf war. Tempted by the score of a lifetime, the former enemies are forced to partner up. But when feelings get involved, their well-laid plans quickly fall apart.

results.title: Adopting St. Nick
results.overview: A single mother finds unexpected romance while helping her daughter connect with a Santa-like resident at a retirement community.

results.title: Promise Street, 1988
results.overview: While working on the unfinished self-portrait of her bedridden mother, a young woman notices an unknown presence in her house.
